course_name: 化工在製藥工業的應用
outline: 本課程將介紹化工知識於製藥工業的應用，安排業界專家專題演講與討論,並將規畫業界參訪行程
schedule:
1. Introduction
2. Role of Chemical Engineering in API R&D
3. Reaction kinetics
4. Process safety
5. Process scale up
6. Solubility and thermodynamics
7. Controlled release technology
assessment:
期中考試
期末考試
學期報告
